text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 50 inmates died in custody and 185 escaped last year amid acts of homosexuality and severe torture in police cells, a prison Inspectorate team said on Wednesday.
- Angry residents in Blantyre on Tuesday applied "Sharia law" by chopping off a hand of a suspected thief, police said on Wednesday.
- Traditional chiefs said they were concerned about the country's weak security because the Malawi constitution allowed bail for suspects hours after they were arrested.

- The opposition party, Alliance for Democracy on Wednesday won the by-elections in Rumphi, northern Malawi, one of its strongholds, beating the main opposition Malawi Congress Party and the ruling United Democratic Front.
